mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is active whenever the rate is trending downward, regardless of absolute level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (above 2.0%) and high unemployment rate (above 4.0%) signals a dual stress of tight monetary policy and weak labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k in the prior month) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE < 4.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential construction activity (HOUST) indicates strong housing market demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals broader economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it indicates economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high CPI index regime (CPIAUCSL > 250.0), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST increase by at least 1% from the prior month.
